name: Nkomo-Lindqvist NLS-20 'Peacekeeper'
description:
The Nkomo-Lindqvist NLS-20 is a pump-action shotgun chambered in 20 gauge designed specifically for civilian home defense, with a built-in trigger lock, a loaded-chamber indicator, and a manual that emphasizes safe storage and handling with the same intensity that other manufacturers dedicate to performance specifications. The barrel is 18 inches with a fixed improved-cylinder choke optimized for buckshot patterning at room distance.

The NLS-20 continues Nkomo-Lindqvist's philosophy of building firearms for people who need protection but aren't firearms enthusiasts. The pump action is deliberately stiff when new — requiring firm, deliberate operation that prevents short-stroking — and loosens to a smooth cycle after a few hundred rounds. The loaded-chamber indicator glows orange when a round is present, visible in darkness without any external light source.

The Peacekeeper competes directly with the Homestead-12 and the Housekeeper for home defense buyers, differentiating on safety features rather than price or performance. Nkomo-Lindqvist's marketing targets households with children, emphasizing the trigger lock, the visible chamber indicator, and the comprehensive safe-handling guide. The weapon is marginally more expensive than competitors but appeals to the safety-conscious demographic that values these features.
specifications:
caliber: 20 gauge
effective_range: 25 meters (buckshot)
rate_of_fire: Pump-action
magazine_capacity: 5+1 rounds
weight: 2.7 kg
tactical_use: A safety-focused home defense shotgun in 20 gauge. The reduced recoil of 20 gauge makes it manageable for all household members. The luminous chamber indicator provides immediate loaded-status verification in darkness. The trigger lock prevents unauthorized use. Performance is adequate for home defense scenarios — the safety features are the primary value proposition.
cultural_context: The NLS-20 is the shotgun equivalent of the Lullaby pistol — a firearm designed with the household environment in mind rather than the battlefield. Families buy it because the marketing speaks to their actual fears: not tactical engagements, but nighttime break-ins in houses where children sleep down the hall.
story_hooks: A child discovers that the luminous chamber indicator on their family's Peacekeeper is glowing when it shouldn't be — someone has been loading the weapon without their parents' knowledge.

Nkomo-Lindqvist's trigger lock system is discovered to have a vulnerability: a strong magnet placed in the right position releases it. The information spreads through Shelf criminal networks before NL can issue a fix.

physical_description.visual_profile: A compact, utilitarian pump-action shotgun with a decidedly civilian aesthetic. The NLS-20 presents as approachable rather than aggressive—a tool designed for the cautious homeowner. Its proportions are balanced and non-threatening, with a stubby 18-inch barrel and rounded receiver lines that avoid tactical angularity.
physical_description.dimensions: Overall length: 94 cm | Barrel length: 45.7 cm | Receiver width: 5.2 cm | Height (with safety selector): 6.8 cm
physical_description.weight_description: Balanced and manageable at 2.7 kg—lighter than full-size 12-gauge home defense platforms. The weight distribution favors the receiver, making the barrel feel responsive rather than nose-heavy. Designed to be shoulderable by various household members without fatigue.
physical_description.primary_material: Injection-molded polymer furniture over steel receiver and barrel. The receiver exhibits steel's characteristic strength beneath matte-finished polymer handguard and foregrip.
physical_description.finish: Matte charcoal polymer with brushed steel receiver visible at ejection port and control surfaces. The barrel wears a non-reflective black oxide finish. All edges show intentional softening—no sharp bevels.
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal-gray polymer dominant, with matte steel accents at mechanical interfaces. The luminous chamber indicator glows soft orange when charged.
physical_description.grip_texture: Rubberized grip panel with subtle texture for wet-hand security. The foregrip features crosshatch polymer molding that's deliberate without being aggressive. Pump handle wraps in soft-touch elastomer for positive purchase.
distinctive_features: Integrated trigger lock mechanism visible as a small cylindrical housing above trigger guard
Luminous chamber indicator: a small orange-glowing element visible from above the receiver, active when round is chambered
Simplified safety lever positioned for thumbs-up operation
Breech block with visual witness marks for manual load verification
Generous ejection port with beveled edges for reliable spent-casing ejection
Sling attachment points molded into polymer—not bolted on
Magazine tube witness holes (5 round capacity visible as small circles along tube)
Smooth pump action with deliberate mechanical resistance markers
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: NKOMO-LINDQVIST logo embossed on left side of receiver in satin finish. Model designation 'NLS-20' etched below ejection port. Serial plate inlaid flush into right receiver side. Small safety warning triangle molded into grip panel. Barrel proof marks stamped at breech in traditional format.
physical_description.condition_typical: Exhibits careful maintenance—polymer shows light surface wear at high-contact points (pump handle, grip), with no cracks. Steel surfaces show minor handling marks but no rust or corrosion. The chamber indicator functions consistently. Magazine tube finish intact. Represents a weapon regularly stored in a safe and brought out for periodic function checks.
